context: Assign Intrinsics / post-array Attribute adjustment during character creation
costRule: Price each +1 separately: 2 × creation IM when the +1 does not increase Attribute DM; 3 × creation IM when the +1 increases Attribute DM.
priorMonthsRule: Justify prior Months equal to the Skillpoint cost; these Months represent Downtime XP at 10 XP per Month and are not paid a second time during character creation.
source: Book III — Character Creation, Post-array Attribute Adjustment
